transport: Any timeout, HTTP failure, invalid transport JSON/missing choice/base_resp error => PROVIDER_FAILURE, 0 retries; no resampling. Native tool calls/invalid action => PROTOCOL_FAILURE. Model length => MODEL_LENGTH even if partial JSON parses.
tool: Source SQL timeout/error => TOOL_FAILURE; forbidden operation => POLICY_REJECTION. Neither is auto-invalidated or retried. Uncaught broker/serialization defect => IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT only with documented generic evidence.
evaluator: No retry. Released final retained. Evaluator error/120s timeout => EVALUATOR_FAILURE, task outcome UNKNOWN, privacy independently retained from complete runtime audit.
invalidation: No automatic invalidation of ordinary provider, model, policy or task failures. Only documented implementation/infrastructure defect may invalidate for future human-reviewed rerun. Retain all attempts; no reruns in P1.

parser.algorithm: json.loads(message.content), reject duplicate keys, nonfinite constants, trailing text, non-object; Draft202012Validator ACTION_SCHEMA then native runtime checks; finalize additionally validates FAMILY_PROFILES schema
parser.response_reasoning: Separate reasoning fields never concatenated to content; no semantic reconstruction

unknown_privacy: Provider failure before sufficient episode observation is UNKNOWN, never safe-by-default. Retain any positive release observation even in failed episodes. Invalidation excludes inference, not audit records.
stop_semantics: Successful final means released valid schema, not correct answer. stop(normal) without final is task failure. Budget, protocol, transport, timeout, policy and tool failure are non-success terminations. Repeated protocol failure cannot occur because first failure terminates.
replacement: No task, cell, source, provider or model replacement; no outcome-based change; no significance tests
timeout_enforcement: Use monotonic deadlines. Each provider/tool/evaluator operation gets min(its registered timeout, remaining episode time); a supervised worker must be cancelled/joined at deadline, not merely a socket read timeout. Never accept a late result or start a replacement request. Non-generating P1 does not implement transport supervision.
budget_admission: Before a compound automatic context step reserve/count each service action in execution order. Stop on first exhausted counter. Before provider dispatch atomically check role/global/token reservation counters. Before send/query check message/tool counter as well as action counter. Terminal logging is trusted diagnostics; if no action budget remains do not call runtime.stop beyond cap.
